description: INMLND2.1 (Institute of Numerical Mathematics Land surface model, version 2.1) is a significantly updated version, based on the land-surface component INMLND1 (used in previous generations of the INM model family). INMLND2.1 simulates the one-dimensional (vertical) dynamics of processes in snow, vegetation and the upper soil layers (Volodin and Lykosov, 1998). This model also includes the terrestrial component of the carbon cycle (Volodin, 2007). Compared to INMLND1, INMLND2.1 features a considerably reworked snow cover scheme that considers the refreezing of liquid water and the evolution of snow layer density (Chernenkov et al., 2024). Consideration of land surface types is also modified, as well as land use changes and crop harvesting are added (Chernenkov and Volodin, 2024).
